class.name: ECSPrefabBridge
class.brief_description: Bridges traditional Godot [PackedScene] workflows with the ECS registry.
class.description: [ECSPrefabBridge] is the primary tool for content creators. it allows for "Bake-at-Runtime" conversion where a standard Godot `.tscn` or `.scn` file is transformed into one or more high-performance ECS entities. This bridge scans the nodes within a scene and automatically maps their properties to corresponding ECS components. For example, a [Sprite2D] node might be converted into a [Transform2DComponent] and a [TextureComponent]. [b]Benefits:[/b] - Use the standard Godot Editor to design levels and characters. - Enjoy the performance of ECS without writing binary data by hand. - Support for nested hierarchies via the [HierarchySystem]. [b]Note:[/b] The bridge is extensible; custom components can be registered to automatically parse specific node metadata during the spawning process.

method.name: spawn_from_scene
method.description: Instantiates the provided [param scene] in memory, converts its root and all children into the ECS representation, and returns the root entity ID. If [param parent] is non-zero, the new entity will be parented to that ID, inheriting its spatial transformations. [b]Performance Tip:[/b] The bridge performs string-based lookup for property mapping. While optimized, avoid calling this 100+ times per frame; batch spawn entities during initialization or level transitions.
